		Dataset Summary
	

WildChat is a collection of 1 million conversations between human users and ChatGPT, alongside demographic data, including state, country, hashed IP addresses, and request headers. We collected WildChat by offering online users free access… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/benchang1110/WildChat-Chinese.
